build_system: None - raw PHP files served by XAMPP Apache
test_command: php -l on each modified PHP file
verification_instructions: Run php -l on each modified PHP file to verify no syntax errors. Manually verify logic flow.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - files are served directly by XAMPP/Apache
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No database available for runtime testing - validate with syntax checks only.
contribution_requirements: Maintain existing CSS style conventions (bg-crema, text-vino, bg-vino, text-dorado, font-serif-elegant, font-sans-clean). Keep Tailwind CSS via CDN. Keep mobile-first approach.
key_patterns: PDO with prepared statements via conexion.php ($pdo variable). Session-based auth with $_SESSION['tutor_autenticado']. Inline CSS/Tailwind classes. Spanish comments. ob_start()/ob_end_flush() pattern for pages with redirects. MATRICULA_USUARIO JS global set from PHP session.
directory_structure: Flat PHP project at /projects/sandbox/SGA-COBAEV/. All PHP files in root. config/ has service-account example. PWA files: sw.js, manifest.json, app.js. Database: MySQL sga_cobaev with tables: alumnos, tutores, asistencias, dispositivos_padres (runtime) / tokens_fcm (in SQL schema).
